capture_surface: native browser screenshots from completed product interactions

chapters.title: Study Coach: an upgraded study workspace
chapters.caption: This walkthrough uses a deterministic local model fixture. Every answer still travels through the real application service and its model transport.

chapters.title: Choose a connection
chapters.caption: Connections lists the built-in models and supported provider templates. A custom endpoint lets you connect another OpenAI-compatible model.

chapters.title: Add a model connection
chapters.caption: The visible connection name identifies the local demonstration fixture. No cloud account, real API key, or billing is used in this recording.

chapters.title: Save and select your study model
chapters.caption: Saved connections show their model, endpoint, and readiness. Use model selects the connection for study, tests, and materials.

chapters.title: Import your source material
chapters.caption: Import a document or screenshot, review the extracted text, then save it. This example imports original Markdown notes; videos require captions or a transcript.

chapters.title: Keep notes in your local workspace
chapters.caption: The preview becomes a saved source only after Save source. Longer text imports are split into bounded source passages.

chapters.title: Ask a question from your notes
chapters.caption: Study uses the selected connection. The original source quotation appears beside the answer so you can inspect its evidence.

chapters.title: Read the source, then check your understanding
chapters.caption: This response is visibly labelled as a local fixture. The service verified its quotation against the saved notes before displaying it.

chapters.title: Build a practice test
chapters.caption: Choose open response, multiple choice, fill in the blank, or a custom format. Choose one to thirty questions; larger tests are generated in smaller batches.

chapters.title: Answer one question at a time
chapters.caption: Starting a test opens a focused question screen. Expected answers and solutions remain on the service until assessment or an explicit reveal.

chapters.title: Yellow: close, with another attempt
chapters.caption: A partly correct explanation turns the test yellow and offers Try again. The solution remains hidden while you refine the answer.

chapters.title: Green: correct, with the reasoning
chapters.caption: A complete explanation turns the test green. A semantically correct paraphrase is accepted, and the source-supported solution becomes visible.

chapters.title: Red: review an incorrect answer
chapters.caption: An incorrect answer turns the test red, locks that outcome, and shows the solution and exact source passage for review.

chapters.title: See solution records a question to revisit
chapters.caption: Reveal is also red. Looking at a solution does not count as answering correctly; the recorded outcome stays fixed.

chapters.title: Finish with a review list
chapters.caption: The summary lists the result of each question. The topic review list is saved locally so you can return to ideas that need practice.

chapters.title: Create notes in your preferred style
chapters.caption: Choose concise, detailed, Cornell, outline, study guide, or custom notes. Document type and instructions are saved with the material.

chapters.title: Keep editable notes and a source-supported diagram
chapters.caption: Generated sections, the relationship diagram, and exact source passages stay together in your local library.

chapters.title: Download an editable Word document
chapters.caption: The Word export contains native editable text, source passages, and a vector diagram. It is a real document download from the Rust service.

chapters.title: Open the print view to save as PDF
chapters.caption: Save as PDF opens a clean printable view with notes, all flashcard answers, diagrams, and source passages. Choose Save as PDF in the print dialog.

chapters.title: Bring the notes into OneNote
chapters.caption: Copy for OneNote prepares rich notes and the diagram. If browser clipboard access is blocked, a downloadable HTML file provides a manual copy-and-paste path.

chapters.title: Use flashcards for active recall
chapters.caption: Create five flashcards from the same source collection. Open a card only after trying to recall the answer yourself.

chapters.title: Make an original mnemonic or study song
chapters.caption: Memory aids map each letter or lyric back to a source fact. This feature creates original text; it does not generate audio.

chapters.title: Return to the ideas worth practicing
chapters.caption: Your review list distinguishes correct attempts from topics to revisit. Saved notes, generated materials, connections, and progress survive reopening the app.

chapters.title: Study Coach: connect, practice, and keep the evidence
chapters.caption: The recorded model responses are deterministic local fixtures. Real account availability, model behavior, and cloud quotas are not claimed by this demonstration.
